description: Partner pack for Linea — ConsenSys zkEVM L2 with full Ethereum bytecode equivalence, MetaMask-native UX. Biases toward consumer dApps that need cheap tx + the widest possible EVM wallet support.

defaults.headline: Ship on Linea — zkEVM with MetaMask-native UX
defaults.subheadline: ConsenSys zkEVM L2; bytecode-equivalent, cheap, first-class MetaMask wallet integration.

buildHints.whenToUse: Prompt mentions Linea, zkEVM L2, MetaMask-integrated dApp, or ConsenSys ecosystem.
firstSteps: Linea mainnet chainId 59144, testnet (Sepolia) 59141. RPCs default to the Infura endpoints in partner-config.json.
Bytecode-equivalent with Ethereum — no Linea-specific opcodes, precompiles, or compiler flags. Deploy exactly as on mainnet.
MetaMask SDK is first-class; prefer `@metamask/sdk` over WalletConnect for Linea consumer flows.
gotchas: Linea withdrawals to L1 have a ~1-3 hour proof window typical for zkEVMs; don't promise instant L2→L1 bridging.
Bridge official only through the Linea-provided bridge (bridge.linea.build) for canonical assets — third-party bridges can mint non-canonical variants.
